samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Zero flag.</output>
        <output id="carry">Carry flag.</output>
        <output id="negative">Negative flag.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Overflow flag.</output>
        <output id="flag">Flag for SLT and SLTU operations.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]">Signed version of 'a'</assign>
        <assign id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]">Signed version of 'b'</assign>
        <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to hold the result of the operation</assign>
        <assign id="shift_amount" width_description="[4:0]">Shift amount for shifting operations</assign>
        <assign id="flag" width_description="[0:0]">Flag for SLT and SLTU operations</assign>
        
        <assign signed_a = $signed(a);
        <assign signed_b = $signed(b);
        <assign res[31:0] = r;
        <assign flag = (aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU) ? 1 : 1'bz;
        <assign zero = (res == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        <assign negative = (res[31] == 1) ? 1 : 0;
        <assign carry = (res > 32'hFFFFFFFF) ? 1 : 0;
        <assign overflow = ((aluc == ADD && (signed_a + signed_b >= 32'h80000000)) ||
                           (aluc == SUB && (signed_a - signed_b <= -32'h80000000))) ? 1 : 0;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        reg [31:0] res;
        reg [4:0] shift_amount;
        always @(*) begin
            case(aluc)
                ADD: res = signed_a + signed_b;
                ADDU: res = a + b;
                SUB: res = signed_a - signed_b;
                SUBU: res = a - b;
                AND: res = a & b;
                OR: res = a | b;
                XOR: res = a ^ b;
                NOR: res = ~(a | b);
                SLT: res = (signed_a < signed_b) ? 1 : 0;
                SLTU: res = (a < b) ? 1 : 0;
                SLL: shift_amount = b[4:0];
                SRL: shift_amount = b[4:0];
                SRA: shift_amount = b[4:0];
                SLLV: shift_amount = a[4:0];
                SRLV: shift_amount = a[4:0];
                SRAV: shift_amount = a[4:0];
                LUI: res = {a[15:0], 16'b0};
                default: res = 32'bz;
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
